PROCEDURE check_drive_feasibility (err_flag out varchar2,
 err_msg out varchar2,
 hold_reason out varchar2) IS
 number_booked number ;
 number_avail number ;
 number_of_drives number:=0;
 piggy_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 number_reqd number ;

 max_allowed number ;
 feasible_flag varchar2(1) ;
 proj_cost number ;
 proj_draw number ;
 drive_time number ;

 total_hrs number ;
 maxcpu number ;
 v_date1 date;
 v_date2 date;

 cursor cur_res is
 select resource_code,resource_desc 
 from valid_resources
 where critical_ind = 'Y'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
BEGIN 
/****
 if :Global.temp_number_reqd is null 
 or :Global.temp_number_reqd = 0 then
***/

 /*** Following added by MG : 110498 ******/
 if NOT (:global.form_status = 'QUERY' 
 and :drive_sponsors.projected_draw = :global.projected_draw
 and :drive_sponsors.projected_show = :global.projected_show
 and to_char(:drives.drive_date,'RRMMDD') = :global.drive_date
 and to_char(:drives.s_sch_end_date,'RRMMDD') = :global.s_sch_end_date
 and :drives.s_schedule_start_time = :global.s_schedule_start_time
 and :drives.s_schedule_end_time = :global.s_schedule_end_time ) then 
 /********************* End Patch ***************/
 estimate_resources ; 
 check_package_failure ; 
 end if;
-- end if;
 err_flag := 'N' ;

 /*-------- Check feasibility for all critical resources one by one. ---------*/
 for cur_resrec in cur_res loop
 if :control_block.drive_id = 'NEW' then /*-- New drive --*/
 don_mcal_common.get_resource_util(:drives.drive_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 null,
 cur_resrec.resource_code,
 number_booked,
 number_avail);
 else /*-- Drive revision --*/
 don_mcal_common.get_resource_util(:drives.drive_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :drives.drive_id,
 cur_resrec.resource_code,
 number_booked,
 number_avail);
 end if ;
 go_block('DRIVE_ESTIMATED_RESOURCES') ; 
 first_record ;
 loop
 /*Start if A1*/
 if :drive_estimated_resources.resource_code = cur_resrec.resource_code then 
 number_reqd := :drive_estimated_resources.number_reqd ;
 if :control_block.drive_id != 'NEW' then /*-- Start if A --*/
 begin /*-- Check if drive is a piggyback --*/
 select drive_id 
 into piggy_drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = :control_block.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 and drive_id != :control_block.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 begin /*-- Check for that resource for the piggy drive --*/
 select nvl(number_reqd,0) 
 into piggy_reqd
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id = piggy_drive_id
 and resource_code = cur_resrec.resource_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 /*-- Whichever drive required more resources is populated to number_reqd --*/
 if piggy_reqd > nvl(:drive_estimated_resources.number_reqd,0) then
 number_reqd := piggy_reqd ;
 else
 number_reqd := nvl(:drive_estimated_resources.number_reqd,0) ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 else /*-- else for if A --*/
 if :control_block.pb_flag = 'Y' then
 adjust_piggyback_resources(cur_resrec.resource_code,number_reqd) ;
 end if ;
 end if ; /*-- End if A --*/
/*
message( 'Res ' || cur_resrec.resource_code 
 || ', Avail= ' || to_char( number_avail ) 
 || ', Booked= ' || to_char( number_booked ) 
 || ', Reqd= ' || to_char( number_reqd ) ); pause;
*/
 
 if number_reqd > (number_avail - number_booked) then
 if number_reqd > 0 then
 err_flag := 'E' ;
 err_msg := 'Not enough '||cur_resrec.resource_desc||', drive not feasible';
 :global.temp_reason := 'NORES';
 return ;
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 exit ; 
 end if ;/*-- End if A1 --*/
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 end if ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ; /*-- End looping DRIVE_ESTIMATED_RESOURCES --*/
 end loop ; /*--- End loop cur_resrec ---*/
 
 -- Check for number of drives on that day, for new drives or if drive date is changed
 if :control_block.drive_id = 'NEW' 
 or :drives.drive_date != :drives.old_drive_date then
 /*---- Get number of drives on the drive date ----*/
 begin
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into number_of_drives
 from drives
 where drive_date = :drives.drive_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status in ('CNFRM','HOLD') ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into max_allowed
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'MAXDR';
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Parameter for Maximum drives allowed not setup') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ; 
 if number_of_drives >= max_allowed then
 err_flag := 'W' ;
 err_msg := 'Too many drives on this day.' ;
 hold_reason := 'TMNDR' ;
 return ;
 end if ;

 -- Check for category rules
 if :control_block.drive_id = 'NEW' then
 check_category_rules(feasible_flag) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if feasible_flag = 'N' then
 err_flag := 'W' ;
 err_msg := 'Category rules violated.' ;
 hold_reason := 'CATRL' ;
 return ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 
 -- Check projected cost
 begin
 select parameter_value into maxcpu
 from valid_parameters
 where --chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 parameter_code = 'MPCPU' ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Parameter for Maximum CPU not setup') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 calc_cpu_onscreen(proj_cost,err_flag) ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message('Projected cost cannot be calculated') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 :drives.projected_cost := ltrim(to_char(proj_cost,'999.99')) ;
 if proj_cost > to_number(maxcpu) then
 err_flag := 'W' ;
 err_msg := 'Drive is not cost-effective.' ;
 hold_reason := 'OCOST' ;
 return ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 
 -- Check maximum hours
 drive_time := to_number(to_date(to_char(:drives.s_sch_end_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||:s_schedule_end_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI') -
 to_date(to_char(:drives.drive_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||:s_schedule_start_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'))*24 ;
 total_hrs := drive_time + (:drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time / 60)+(2*:control_block.travel_time/60) ;
 
 begin
 if total_hrs > :control_block.max_hours then
 err_flag := 'W' ;
 err_msg := 'Total hours exceed maximum hours allowed for a drive.' ;
 hold_reason := 'DMXHR' ;
 return ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when value_error then
 message('Value error while checking max. hours') ;
 handle_error ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ; 

 -- Check if day is closed
 begin
 select 'x' 
 into :global.x
 from calendar_highlights
 where hi_date = :drives.drive_date
 and hi_status = 'CLOSD' ;
 err_flag := 'W' ;
 err_msg := 'This day is closed for new drives.' ;
 hold_reason := 'CLOSD' ;
 return ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

 into avg_rate

 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

 /*-- Show must be greater than zero --*/

 :global.src_item := :system.cursor_item ;
 go_block('drive_piggy') ;
 first_record ; 
 loop
 if :drive_piggy.pb_sel_flag = 'Y' then 
 if (:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time between
 to_date(to_char(:drives.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY')||' '||
 :drives.s_schedule_start_time,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') and

 :drives.s_schedule_end_time,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'))

 (:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time between

 :drives.s_schedule_start_time,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') and

 :drives.s_schedule_end_time,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI')) then
 go_item(:global.src_item) ; 
 show_error('11269') ; 
 check_package_failure ; 
 end if ;
 exit ; 
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ; 
 go_item(:global.src_item) ;
 end if ; 


 /*-- Ensure that at least one facility is selected --*/

------------IF for drive I

 first_record;
